note: Rough visual counts from montages in figs/ (same physical scene = overlapping view of the same road spot). Eyeball judgements, not a formal annotation.
dinov2_sim>=0.90_but_<13_inliers_(calib_: ~1/16 same scene; rest = same ride/different spot or look-alike pavement texture -> DINOv2 similarity alone is not a reliable near-duplicate test
full_image_high_top60_low_(calib_fullhig: dominated by identical ego vehicle (red fairing, 'AZ' plate) on different road segments -> full-image embedding is confounded by the rig
sift_upper60%_before_fix: license plate of the 1080-px rig reaches into the upper 60% and produced false matches (~3/16 in the 16-20 and 20-25 bands); fixed by keeping keypoints in the upper 50% and dropping static (<4 px) matches
chosen_rule: edge if moving inliers >= 15 or DINOv2 top60 cos >= 0.96; weak edges (15-29 inliers) are used for grouping only with triangle support or a leaf endpoint, then merged afterwards with a group-size cap of 250
cross_resolution_edges: 7 accepted edges linked different resolution groups; all 7 were false positives on visual inspection (nd_crossres_pairs.jpg)
